productScope.title: From the first estimate to the last withdrawal
productScope.description: This working prototype calculates in your browser but does not read your wallet or live CKB data. The full version is planned to help holders understand, track, and manage each Nervos DAO position.

current.title: Edit a CKB scenario
current.description: Enter a balance, choose an assumed annual rate, and compare periods from 1 to 60 months.

current.title: Compare DAO and outside DAO
current.description: See an estimated DAO increase beside a modeled change in supply share outside DAO. The comparison is not CKB removed from a wallet.

current.title: Understand the deposit and exit path
current.description: See the 102 CKB cell-space assumption, the 180-epoch lock, and the request and completion withdrawal steps.

current.title: Inspect the math and sources
current.description: Read the simplified formula, assumptions, model limits, and links to Nervos protocol references.

planned.title: Read a wallet's DAO positions
planned.description: Connect a supported CKB wallet to list multiple deposits and pending withdrawals. Reading the address does not give the app control of funds.

planned.title: Use current DAO data
planned.description: Read each deposit's amount, deposit epoch, and on-chain DAO data to show its estimated increase in CKB, withdrawal status, and when the final step becomes available. Future amounts remain estimates.

planned.title: Prepare a deposit for wallet approval
planned.description: Show the amount, cell space, destination, and network fee before the user reviews and signs the transaction in their wallet.

planned.title: Guide both withdrawal steps
planned.description: Show the request and completion steps, expected CKB, current fees, and the 180-epoch eligibility from the deposit. The first step does not return CKB to your wallet; after you sign the final step, the original deposit capacity plus the DAO increase is sent to the chosen address, minus fees.

planned.title: Send Telegram reminders
planned.description: Opt in for a reminder as a deposit approaches 180 epochs, then another when live chain data confirms the final withdrawal step is ready. Each message links to the position; the bot only reminds and never signs or sends transactions.

planned.title: Keep a transaction history
planned.description: Show deposits, withdrawal requests, and completed withdrawals with explorer links. CKB remains the amount you receive; an optional USD view is only a price estimate with its update time shown.

faq.title: Questions to settle before you deposit

card.title: Check the protocol source
card.text: Use the current Nervos documentation and transaction details before signing.

items.q: Is this connected to the CKB network?
items.a: No. The prototype has no wallet connection, RPC request, live rate, fee quote, or transaction submission.
No. It is a simplified scenario based on an editable constant rate and duration. The live DAO uses accumulated-rate values recorded by the protocol.

items.q: Does the 102 CKB cell space increase too?
items.a: No. The standard DAO cell uses 102 CKB for storage. The estimate applies to the remaining amount. Network fees are extra.

items.q: How long is the minimum lock?
items.a: The protocol minimum is 180 epochs from the deposit epoch. Calendar time varies with epoch length.

items.q: Can I withdraw in one transaction?
items.a: Withdrawal has a request phase and a separate completion phase after maturity conditions are met. Review the current protocol process before acting.

items.q: Does the estimate include primary issuance or CKB price changes?
items.a: No. The model focuses on a secondary-issuance scenario and does not include primary issuance, market price changes, transaction fees, or custom lock scripts.
